Real exam item: 'The word Biodiversity was coined by' — official answer W. G. Rosen (1985). The fetched NCERT text says only that Edward Wilson POPULARISED the term; the coinage fact is not in the source, so it is not taught as a claim. The section's exam_note discloses the distinction openly so the student can still choose Rosen when the question says 'coined' and Wilson when it says 'popularised'.
